{{Top}}
[[File:Shuttle_CHRON.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] was a well-known model]]
{{Quote|Inform the commander that Lord Vader's shuttle has arrived.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Endicott/Legends|Endicott]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A '''shuttle''' or '''shuttlecraft''' was a small vessel used to transport personnel, usually at least partially through space. Many different types of shuttles existed. Some were designed only to carry people from a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] orbit to its surface, or from one larger ship to another located nearby. However, many shuttles were fitted with their own [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and could thus travel great distances. Military shuttles used for the collection or delivery of [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were usually referred to as '''troop shuttles''' or '''troop transports'''.

{{Ship-stub}}
